title: Potentiometer LED dimmer
goal: A reader must be able to follow the potentiometer wiper into a transistor driver that varies current through an LED string.

rubric.must: P1 is visibly a three-terminal potentiometer with a readable wiper connection.
The two outer potentiometer terminals visibly connect to 12 V and ground.
A 4.7 kΩ base resistor and 100 kΩ pull-down are visible between the wiper, transistor base, and ground.
The NPN transistor visibly switches the LED string on the low side.
A 330 Ω current-limiting resistor is visible in series with the LED string.
The 12 V source, 10 kΩ potentiometer, and three-LED string labels are legible.

ideal.notes: Reviewed. The potentiometer's track spans supply and return with its wiper feeding the base resistor, the base carries a pull-down, and the LED string with its limiting resistor sits between the supply and the collector.
